newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Minfins quiet, position-squaring seen.
newsitem.headline: Russian Minfins quiet, position-squaring seen.

text.p: Prices of the fifth and sixth tranches of Russian MinFin bonds edged up on position-squaring in otherwise quiet Friday trading, dealers said.

They added the market was awaiting clues for further moves in Russia and from U.S. Treasury bonds next week, as the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is meeting on Tuesday to deliberate interest rates.
"It is just some minutes ago that we have seen some moves. People have been sleeping the whole day," Avtobank dealer Ivan Kuznetsov said.
Dealers said tiny deals were seen in 2008 and 2006 maturities, apparently on low-scale position-squaring by some Western banks.
"Maybe people prefer to do what they wanted today instead of waiting for next week, when no one one knows what will happen," Kuznetsov added, referring to the FOMC meeting.
